name: e-Spatial
story: Matti Seikkula and Simon Jellie co-founded e-Spatial, which began operating in 1998 and was incorporated in 1999. The company worked in location intelligence, land and property information, connecting geographic data with business systems. A merger with Harrison Grierson was announced in 2017.
